mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( member_id, class_id, rating, content ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{classId}, #{rating}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, member_id AS memberId, class_id AS classId, rating, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, member_id AS memberId, class_id AS classId, rating, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND class_id = #{classId}
SELECT review_id AS reviewId, member_id AS memberId, class_id AS classId, rating, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
